legend: Bone marrow core biopsy shows almost maximal cellularity, marked myeloid hyperplasia with eosinophilia, and increased megakaryocytes without cluster formation; megakaryocytes are variable in morphology and include small and hypolobated forms (<<36663>>). Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased eosinophils, including eosinophilic myelocytes and degranulated eosinophils lacking overt dysplasia in the myeloid or erythroid series (Giemsa).

FISH confirms rearrangements involving ETV6 using a dual-colour break-apart rearrangement probe (centromeric 3′ ETV6, spectrum green; telomeric 5′ ETV6, spectrum orange) (<<40962>>) and ABL1 using a dual-colour break-apart rearrangement probe (centromeric 5′ ABL1, spectrum orange; telomeric 3′ ABL1, spectrum green) (<<40963>>).
